body.statement: For a generic two-dimensional subspace and three-coordinate restrictions, relation vectors indexed by a set \(F\) of triples are linearly independent if and only if every nonempty \(F'\subseteq F\) satisfies \(|F'|\leq |V(F')|-2\). Consequently their generic rank is \(r_{1,2}(H_3)\).

source.locator: Lemma 1 and Theorem 1; see also the Appendix theorem under Generalization of Our Results
source.verbatim_statement: For almost every S*, the columns of A are linearly dependent if and only if n(A)>m(A)-r for some matrix A formed with a subset of the columns of A.

attestation.note: Verified 2026-09-14 against the primary arXiv v3 TeX source downloaded from https://export.arxiv.org/e-print/1410.0633v3, identifiability.tex, independence lemma and Theorem 1. Specializing r=2 and three-supported relation columns gives independence exactly when every nonempty F-prime obeys |F-prime| <= |V(F-prime)|-2.
